description: This file defines a Context class for managing browser contexts, tabs, routes, and video recordings in Playwright testing framework. It includes configuration types, route management, tab handling, and utility functions related to file output and URL checking.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Manages Playwright browser context, tabs, routes, videos, and configuration for testing.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources, tabs, and stops video recording.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns the list of open tabs.

methods.name: currentTab
methods.description: Returns the current active tab.

methods.name: currentTabOrDie
methods.description: Returns the current tab or throws if none is available.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates and returns a new tab.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Selects a tab by index.

methods.name: ensureTab
methods.description: Ensures a tab is open and returns it.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes a tab by index or current.

methods.name: workspaceFile
methods.description: Resolves a workspace file path.

methods.name: outputFile
methods.description: Generates an output file path.

methods.name: startVideoRecording
methods.description: Starts video recording for the context.

methods.name: stopVideoRecording
methods.description: Stops video recording and returns videos.

methods.name: _startPageVideo
methods.description: Starts video recording on a page.

methods.name: _onPageCreated
methods.description: Handles new page creation.

methods.name: _onPageClosed
methods.description: Handles page closure.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Returns current route entries.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a route to the context.

methods.name: removeRoute
methods.description: Removes routes by pattern or all.

methods.name: isRunningTool
methods.description: Checks if a tool is running.

methods.name: setRunningTool
methods.description: Sets the name of the running tool.

methods.name: _setupRequestInterception
methods.description: Sets up network request interception based on config.

methods.name: ensureBrowserContext
methods.description: Ensures the browser context is initialized.

methods.name: _initializeBrowserContext
methods.description: Initializes the browser context with scripts, tracing, and event handlers.

methods.name: checkUrlAllowed
methods.description: Checks if URL access is permitted.

methods.name: lookupSecret
methods.description: Retrieves secret value or code.
